qa-settings-batch3.title: QA Batch 3 — Settings tests (S1-S12)
qa-settings-batch3.description:
Implement 12 Compose instrumented tests for the Settings surface, following the pattern from Batches 1-2. Flat layout under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/, prefer text or contentDescription, testTag only when needed, org.junit.Assert (NEVER kotlin built-in assert which is a no-op without -ea).

Test IDs per bootstrap plan (doc/todo/qa_test/final/cn/bootstrap_plan.md Batch 3):
S1  Sheet_OpensToHomePage
S2  Sheet_DismissClosesSheet
S3  Sheet_BackFromSubPageReturnsToHome
S4  Sheet_PageStateSurvivesRotation (rememberSaveable)
S5  LlmAuth_TabSwitchDoesNotCommitBackend
S6  LlmAuth_OAuthStartCommitsBackendAndMethod
S7  LlmAuth_ApiKeyProviderSwitchesModelOptions
S8  LlmAuth_IncompatibleModelAutoResetsOnMethodSwitch
S9  AgentBehavior_ProModeShowsExecutorDropdown
S10 Permissions_SessionTracesToggleShowsWarningBanner
S11 Permissions_ClearTracesShowsConfirmDialog
S12 Permissions_ClearTracesConfirmDisablesButton

Relevant source files under app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/settings/: SettingsSheet, SettingsHomePage, LlmAuthSettingsPage, AgentBehaviorSettingsPage, PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage, SettingsModels, SettingsDropdowns, SettingsWidgets.

Pattern rules (non-negotiable):
- org.junit.Assert for verdicts, NEVER kotlin built-in assert
- Flat layout, group into a few files by theme (SettingsNavTest, SettingsLlmAuthTest, SettingsAgentBehaviorTest, SettingsPermissionsTest)
- testTag in production only when text or contentDescription is not a stable selector
- For S4 rotation: use StateRestorationTester from androidx.compose.ui.test to exercise rememberSaveable without actually rotating
- For S8 model canonicalization: call the composable with an incompatible provider/model pair and assert onModelChange fires with a valid model, OR that the dropdown shows only valid options
acceptCriteria: All 12 S1-S12 tests exist as @Test methods under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/
grep -RE on kotlin built-in assert under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/ returns no matches
testTag additions in app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/settings/ are minimal and justified
qa-settings-batch3.note: 45 tests green total (17 Batch 1 + 15 Batch 2 + 13 Batch 3 — S9 split into Pro/Basic halves). Codex review caught 2 blockers (S9 false positive via shared Executor Model title, S11 text-only dialog check); both fixed in ffae2baa.
